inference_boundary.interpretation: Patterns co-occur in the supplied award artifacts; they are candidate award-associated mechanisms, not identified causes of winning.

scope.use_boundary: Abstract mechanisms only. Do not copy protected expression, data, questionnaire wording, code, images, or visual assets.

patterns.name: hook_plus_boundary
patterns.mechanism: A memorable cultural or linguistic hook attracts attention while the full title narrows the population and object and may also state geography or decision context.
patterns.agent_rule: Score title recall and narrowing separately, then require the problem statement to complete the operational boundary.

patterns.name: decision_tension
patterns.mechanism: The topic contains a consequential contradiction or friction that a named actor must resolve.
patterns.agent_rule: Write the decision owner, decision, affected population, evidence gap, and core tension before selecting methods.

patterns.name: bounded_hot_topic
patterns.mechanism: A broad social or market trend is narrowed to a reachable local population, event, occupation, or consumption domain.
patterns.agent_rule: Reject a fashionable topic until respondent access and an operational boundary are explicit.

patterns.name: exploration_to_instrument
patterns.mechanism: Literature plus interviews, observation, or social listening is reported as supplying constructs and questionnaire modules; this is not verified chronology, and one case contains a disclosed date conflict.
patterns.agent_rule: Require a dated trace from exploratory evidence to each survey construct; chronology conflicts remain blocking.

patterns.name: visible_research_labor
patterns.mechanism: Pilot work, quality control, achieved sample, fieldwork process, and supporting artifacts are visibly disclosed; visibility is not independent authentication.
patterns.agent_rule: Treat fieldwork credibility as a designed evidence product, not a prose assurance.

patterns.name: two_axis_segmentation
patterns.mechanism: A population or experience-status split is combined with a context, category, occupation, region, service, or profile split.
patterns.agent_rule: Test two meaningful segmentation axes when supported; reject decorative or unstable personas.

patterns.name: analysis_ladder
patterns.mechanism: Analysis advances from baseline description to differences or drivers, segmentation, mechanism or priority, and action.
patterns.agent_rule: Every method declares one narrative job, upstream input, downstream output, and decision use.

patterns.name: mother_insight
patterns.mechanism: One explanatory idea integrates otherwise separate model outputs and remains stable across conclusion and action.
patterns.agent_rule: Require a concise evidence-bounded mother insight; reject slogan-only synthesis.

patterns.name: finding_action_correspondence
patterns.mechanism: Most headline findings and segments have a clear recommendation counterpart.
patterns.agent_rule: Maintain a finding-to-action coverage map and remove orphan findings or unsupported actions.

patterns.name: report_deck_role_separation
patterns.mechanism: The report carries the proof burden while the deck rebuilds a decision story instead of shrinking the table of contents.
patterns.agent_rule: Freeze facts first, then plan the deck from decision tension, proof set, named conclusions, and action.

patterns.name: analysis_first_deck_allocation
patterns.mechanism: Differentiated findings occupy the largest content block; routine background and validity checks are compressed.
patterns.agent_rule: Allocate the largest deck block to non-obvious findings without hiding material limitations.

patterns.name: topic_bound_visual_identity
patterns.mechanism: A topic-specific cover, palette, navigation, and synthesis graphic reinforce recall while evidence pages remain formal.
patterns.agent_rule: Define a project-specific visual grammar and verify that decoration never displaces evidence or anonymity controls.

observed_deck_content_allocation.basis: two supplied decks; excludes cover, agenda, section dividers, and closing slides
observed_deck_content_allocation.interpretation: Observed pattern, not a mandatory slide-count template.
